subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should this umbrella stay open as one item, and which operator-visible surface should non-tool skill prompt rewrites use?
rationale: The missing code paths are clear, but the status performance boundary and the prompt-rewrite diagnostic UX are product choices rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Split into focused follow-ups
options.body: Track status registry diagnostics separately from prompt-rewrite diagnostics, choose the warning surface first, and keep each implementation bounded with tests.

options.title: Keep this umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker for both remaining quick wins, accepting that implementation crosses status, skills, docs, and tests.

options.title: Narrow to status diagnostics
options.body: Treat existing skill docs and checks as enough for prompt-rewrite discovery and keep only the status registry diagnostics request.

recommendation.title: Split into focused follow-ups
recommendation.body: Track status registry diagnostics separately from prompt-rewrite diagnostics, choose the warning surface first, and keep each implementation bounded with tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already posted the prior keep-open review and is the clearest routing candidate for deciding whether to split or sponsor the remaining UX surface.
